description: Suggest a LoRA without registering it or spending money. query can be a project alias, a registered LoRA name, an adapter id, or a public Hugging Face link. Show the user the say field. If intent is use, pass inputPatch.adapters on image.generate.v1. If intent is suggest, wait for the user to agree, then call hydracept_use_lora with accept.arguments. If intent is choose, ask the question in say, then call hydracept_use_lora with file_path or base_model_family. Do not invent repository paths, commits, weight filenames, or base-model families.
name: hydracept_suggest_lora
title: Suggest a LoRA
